# Results for the paper (generated by make_report.py from results/*.csv)

IMPORTANT: every number below comes from a SYNTHETIC simulation (600 workers, 8 skill clusters/48 skills,
100 fresh tasks per epoch, 6 epochs, 20 independent random seeds). It validates that the framework works end-to-end and
shows how its components behave under stated assumptions. It is NOT evidence about real platforms.

## Table A. Main comparison (epochs 1-5, mean ± 95% CI over 20 seeds)
| System | P@1 | P@5 | R@5 | F1@5 | NDCG@5 | Note |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| TF-IDF keyword | 0.198 ± 0.007 | 0.188 ± 0.006 | 0.199 ± 0.006 | 0.193 ± 0.006 | 0.268 ± 0.005 | Keyword baseline (i) |
| Semantic (skill graph) | 0.182 ± 0.010 | 0.186 ± 0.006 | 0.200 ± 0.005 | 0.193 ± 0.005 | 0.261 ± 0.006 | Semantic baseline (ii); skill graph stands in for SBERT |
| Supervised ranker | 0.619 ± 0.038 | 0.579 ± 0.038 | 0.651 ± 0.043 | 0.613 ± 0.041 | 0.752 ± 0.042 | Gradient-boosted ranker (iii), trained on earlier epochs only |
| Two-sided preference | 0.698 ± 0.010 | 0.599 ± 0.008 | 0.666 ± 0.007 | 0.631 ± 0.007 | 0.792 ± 0.004 | Two-sided preference baseline (iv) |
| Tuned claims-only score | 0.738 ± 0.008 | 0.687 ± 0.009 | 0.777 ± 0.007 | 0.729 ± 0.007 | 0.847 ± 0.003 | Control: same weight tuning, but no verification and no performance |
| Full framework | 0.903 ± 0.010 | 0.753 ± 0.010 | 0.843 ± 0.006 | 0.795 ± 0.008 | 0.903 ± 0.002 | Proposed framework |
| Oracle (ceiling) | 1.000 ± 0.000 | 0.883 ± 0.008 | 1.000 ± 0.000 | 0.938 ± 0.004 | 1.000 ± 0.000 | Ground-truth ceiling, not a real system |

Metric definitions: P@k = share of top-k that are truly suitable; R@k = suitable workers found in top-k divided by min(k, number of suitable workers);
F1@5 = harmonic mean of P@5 and R@5; NDCG@5 uses graded true suitability. Evaluated on tasks with at least one suitable worker.

## Other numbers
- Learned weights (full framework, dev-tuned): skill 0.09, ver 0.02, exp 0.00, pref 0.82, avail 0.06, perf 0.01.
- lambda sensitivity (NDCG@5, weights fixed): 0.1 -> 0.904; 0.3 -> 0.903; 0.5 -> 0.902; 0.9 -> 0.899.
- Weight robustness: 30 random ±30% perturbations of the weights -> NDCG@5 0.903 vs 0.903.
- Cold start (epoch 0) NDCG@5: full 0.889; tuned claims-only 0.852; without verification 0.851; two-sided preference 0.791.
- Verification module in simulation: precision of accepted claims 0.984; recall of submitted true skills 0.921; decision accuracy 0.920;
  false claims rejected 0.635, false claims wrongly accepted 0.057; evidence submitted for 0.696 of claims.
  (These are set by the simulated verifier's assumed true/false-accept rates 0.92/0.08 and submission rates, so they are a consistency check, not a finding.)
- Latency (single CPU core, 600 workers): 11.3 ms per recommendation including explanation; 0.0035 ms per profile update.
- Explanation coverage: 100% by construction (every recommendation carries factor contributions and blocking reasons).
- Summary of increments: verification adds +0.020 NDCG@5 on top of everything else; profile updates add +0.006; the full framework beats the tuned claims-only control by +0.056.
